pins.definition: The organ in the body that you use to see.
One of the two organs on your face that you see with.
The organ of sight in humans and animals.

situation: An optometrist examines a detailed anatomical chart mounted on an office wall.
subject: the human eye
brief: A single human eye fills the center of the framed plate, rendered in precise lines and muted watercolours, showing the iris fibres and dark pupil clearly. Surrounding the large central organ are small, delicate diagrams of the optic nerve and cornea, labeled with fine nineteenth-century script.
